description: Pre-algebra repeated-groups MCQs that mix a rule-derived setup premise with a native ADJ solve. Each program derives a setup atom from observed quantities, uses that derived atom to fire a queried decision with an evidence proof, then solves the requested total from the observed values.

items.stem: There are 7 boxes with 8 pencils in each box. How many pencils are there in all?
items.program:
prior 0.001 for setup_ready
contributes 1000000 from repeated_groups_problem to setup_ready
observe groups(7)
observe per_group(8)
rule { head: repeated_groups_problem when: groups(7), per_group(8) }
? setup_ready
symbol x : scalar
constrain x = groups * per_group
solve for { x }
